# GitHub Actions — retired for origin CI

MuxCore origin CI runs on **Forgejo** (`git.zem.systems`) via `.forgejo/workflows/`.

These `.github/workflows` files are legacy mirrors for a future public GitHub org. Do not register GitHub runners or treat GitHub CI as the merge gate.

See [`_mvp/tls/FORGEJO-RUNNER.md`](../_mvp/tls/FORGEJO-RUNNER.md) and [`_mvp/tls/GITHUB-RUNNER.md`](../_mvp/tls/GITHUB-RUNNER.md).
